title: Segment Tree: Range Sum with Point Updates
contract: Operations [0,index,value] assign a value; [1,left,right] query an inclusive range sum. Return query answers; array is nonempty.
brute: long[] values=new long[a.length];for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++)values[i]=a[i];List<Long> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] op:ops){if(op[0]==0)values[op[1]]=op[2];else{long sum=0;for(int i=op[1];i<=op[2];i++)sum+=values[i];out.add(sum);}emit("Scan each queried range","operation",op,"values",values,"answers",out);}return out;
optimal: int n=a.length;long[] tree=new long[2*n];for(int i=0;i<n;i++)tree[n+i]=a[i];for(int i=n-1;i>0;i--)tree[i]=tree[2*i]+tree[2*i+1];List<Long> out=new ArrayList<>();for(int[] op:ops){if(op[0]==0){int i=n+op[1];tree[i]=op[2];while(i>1){i/=2;tree[i]=tree[2*i]+tree[2*i+1];}}else{int l=n+op[1],r=n+op[2]+1;long sum=0;while(l<r){if((l&1)==1)sum+=tree[l++];if((r&1)==1)sum+=tree[--r];l/=2;r/=2;}out.add(sum);}emit("Update ancestors or combine disjoint covering segments","operation",op,"tree",tree,"answers",out);}return out;
reasoning: Direct point assignment is cheap, but every range query scans the covered values.
Store leaves in the second half and parent sums above them. Each parent summarizes a disjoint segment.
Use a half-open query [left,right+1): odd boundary nodes are consumed before moving to parents. Range updates require a separate lazy-propagation design; this lab implements point assignment.
